tut.done.title: Tutorial complete!
tut.done.body: Now you know Tablić. In a real run you buy Regulars at the Bar between rounds to multiply your score.
tut.0.0: Welcome to the tavern! Up top is the table, below is your hand. The goal of the round is 75 points.
tut.0.1: With a hand card you capture a table card of the same value. Suit doesn't matter. Click 7♣, then 7♥ on the table, then CAPTURE.
tut.0.2: That's a Pair. Score is always Chips × Mult: every card gives chips, the capture type gives the base.
tut.0.3: Face cards are worth more: J = 12, Q = 13, K = 14. Capture K♠ with your K♦.
tut.0.4: One more. Find the pair yourself!
tut.1.0: You can also capture by sum: several table cards adding up to your card. An Ace is 1 or 11 — the game picks for you.
tut.1.2: The Ace counted as 1 for the sum, but always scores 11 chips. One card was left, so the table refilled to 4.
tut.1.3: Now your A♥ is worth 11. Find table cards adding up to 11 and capture them.
tut.2.0: One card can capture several groups at once — each group must add up to your card.
tut.2.1: Click 9♥, pick 9♣ (first group) and 4♦ + 5♥ (second group), then CAPTURE. Two groups make a Double!
tut.2.2: Look at K♣ (14): J♠ + 2♠ = 14, but 6♣ + 5♦ = only 11. You're missing 3.
tut.2.3: That's what LAYING is for: a card goes to the table without scoring and sets up a future sum. Pick 3♥ and press LAY.
tut.2.4: Now K♣ takes J♠ + 2♠ and 6♣ + 5♦ + 3♥ — the whole table! Clearing the table is a TABLA: +40 chips and ×2 Mult. CAPTURE!

rules.title: Rules
rules.body:
Capturing

Pick a hand card and table cards. The selection is valid if the table cards can be split into groups that each add up to your card's value. A group of one card = same value.

Values: Ace 1 or 11, 2–10 face value, J = 12, Q = 13, K = 14.

Capture types

Pair (1 card) · Sum (1 group of 2+ cards) · Double (2 groups) · Triple (3+ groups). Clearing the whole table is a Tabla: +40 chips and ×2 Mult.

Score

Score = Chips × Mult. Every captured card gives chips (Ace 11, faces 10, 10♦ +20, 2♣ +15). Regulars add chips and mult in order, left to right.

Round

You have 5 captures and 3 lays. Laying puts a card on the table without scoring — that's how you set up future sums. If no card can capture and you have no lays, a forced lay costs 1 capture.

Run

8 taverns, each with 3 rounds: Early guests, Evening shift and a Boss who changes the rules. Between rounds, at the Bar, you buy Regulars, Brandies (level up capture types) and Cups (change your cards).

Controls

Mouse/touch. Keyboard: arrows, Enter, C = CAPTURE, V = LAY, B = BEST, Esc = back. Gamepad: A select, X CAPTURE, Y LAY, B back, LB/RB hand/table.

mode.title: Choose a game mode
mode.rogue.name: Tavern adventure
mode.rogue.desc: A single-player roguelite. There is no opponent — you play against a score target. Between rounds you hire tavern regulars who multiply your score.
mode.rogue.goal: 🎯 Goal: survive 8 taverns and beat 8 bosses.
mode.classic.name: Classic Tablić
mode.classic.desc: Real Tablić 1-on-1 against the computer, with traditional rules: take turns, capture cards and collect points.
mode.classic.goal: 🎯 Goal: score more points than the computer.
goal.title: How to win
goal.lead: You don't play against an opponent — you play against a score target.
goal.step1: Every round has a score target. Reach it within 5 captures and the round is yours.
goal.step2: Score is Chips × Mult. Sum, Double, Triple and Tabla are worth far more than a Pair.
goal.step3: After a win, at the Bar you hire regulars — they multiply every capture. Later taverns are impossible without them.
goal.step4: Get through 8 taverns. The third round of each is a Boss who changes the rules. Beat the last one and you win.
goal.best: You can use the BEST button only {n} time per round — the rest is up to you.
classic.hint: Your turn: pick a hand card, then capture or lay.
classic.noCapture: This card can't capture anything — lay it or pick another.
classic.rules: Capture a card of the same value or cards adding up to your card (A 1/11, J 12, Q 13, K 14). Points: 10, J, Q, K and A 1 each, 10♦ 2, 2♣ 1. Most cards (27+) gets 3. Each Tabla 1. Cards left on the table go to whoever captured last.
